items.label: Smart Display Base with Control
items.value: The ThermoMaven G1 wireless meat thermometer features a versatile smart display base that offers real-time temperature readings and allows you to set temperatures directly on the device—no app required. With our user-friendly one-click setup, you can connect the probe, pair it with the base, and start cooking in seconds—no complicated setup needed!

items.label: Reliable Sub-1G Connectivity
items.value: Experience stable, long-range monitoring with our advanced Sub-1G technology, allowing you to track your food from up to 3000 feet away (unobstructed) and 700 feet in obstructed areas via the smart base. Enjoy the freedom to relax and socialize without being tied to the grill!

items.label: NIST Certified 6-Sensor Precision
items.value: The ThermoMaven G1 digital meat thermometer features 6 sensors (5 internal and 1 external) with NIST-certified accuracy of ±0.5°F and a resolution of 0.01°F. Enjoy the confidence of perfectly cooked meals every time, ensuring your food is never undercooked or overcooked.

items.label: High-Heat Resistance & IPX8 Waterproof
items.value: The wireless meat probe withstands the internal meat temperature up to 221°F and the ambient temperature up to 752°F, making it perfect for grilling, roasting, and any culinary adventure. With a superior IPX8 waterproof rating, the ThermoMaven probes are dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup. The smart base is splash-resistant design, kindly wipe clean with a damp cloth—enjoy your meal without the hassle!

items.label: App-Controlled Cooking
items.value: Say goodbye to tangled wires! Our Bluetooth meat thermometer monitors your cooking progress via Wi-Fi using the free ThermoMaven App. Set alerts, track temperatures, and achieve perfect results every time from your phone. Compatible with iOS and Android devices, available on the App Store and Google Play!

items.label: All-Day Battery for Long Cooks
items.value: Designed for serious BBQ and smoking. The meat probe achieves a full charge in just 30 minutes, yielding up to 24 hours of continuous use. Accompanied by a base that recharges in 3 hours for 24 hours of steady monitoring, ThermoMaven is your reliable partner. Whether you're grilling a quick weeknight steak or managing a 12-hour overnight smoke, your cook is never interrupted.

items.label: Exceptional After-Sales Support
items.value: At ThermoMaven, your satisfaction is our top priority. Our meat thermometer comes with a comprehensive 18-month assurance and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. For any questions or concerns, our dedicated customer service team is available 24/7 to provide prompt assistance. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that expert support is just an email away!
